_comment: Traditional-Chinese (Taiwan) strings, hand-translated from en.json following docs/i18n/zh-TW-termbase.md — never converted from zh.json. Mirrors every key of zh.json in the same order (Gate D of scripts/verify-zhtw.mjs); resolved per page via the eleventyComputed `t` lookup (lang: zh-tw → zh-tw.json, falling back to zh.json, then en.json). Proper nouns, the brand 'EBiM Benchmark' and product names (Mobile FR3 Duo) stay in Latin. HTML entities ( /©/—) are kept literal and emitted with the `safe` filter, exactly as in en.json. The meta.* and jsonld.* strings of pages not yet drafted are re-read against each finished page in the stage that drafts it.
